title: Assume Mode
style: Dark alt-pop with off-beat noir swing and a tense half-time pulse; verse rides sparse keys, clipped bass, and dry hand percussion, pre-chorus strips to a filtered piano pulse and rising whispers, chorus hits with stacked gang vocals and a sharp synth stab on the hook word. Vocal is close-mic, slightly strained in verses, doubled on hooks, with delay throws on key phrases. Ear candy: reversed swells into each chorus, tape-stop flicks on “lock it down,” and tiny glitch clicks between lines. Mix is moody, wide, and punchy with a smoky cinematic edge., breaks, clean
lyrics:
[Intro]
Yeah…
assume mode…
No stall tonight…

[Hook]
Assume mode — no ask, just build it
Hands on the keys, keep it committed
One step locked, next one live
Proof on the disk, that’s how we thrive
No stop — let me hear what you got
Safe and sound, drop it hot
From the chest to the content, pen to the page
My Song Pal… we break the cage

[Verse 1]
No menu loops, no polite stall
Short words, hard facts, keep the signal tall
If it breaks, we log it clean
If it works, we ship that thing
No drift pattern, no lost grip
Direct hits in the digital crypt
Log the error, fix the frame
Ship the win, repeat the game

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold up — it’s not all luck
We all got this thing, let it ring
You can look, read the book
Have a good look again…

[Chorus]
You can tell me what you want to
You can believe it if you want to
You really wanna know?
Think like that
Yeah… like that!
Enough with the fluff
No dislikes — I like that!
No dislikes, no dislikes
Yeah, that’s what I like!
We ain’t gonna roll like that
Stat stat stat — sing it back!
From your chest to my content
Like a pen pal…
My Song Pal!

[Verse 2]
Assume sometimes, unless you ask
We all have to navigate that
We do not assume — but we have to
Assume the build, assume the breakthrough
Assume the win when the proof is there
Assume the flow when the code is clear
No more guessing in the dead of night
Build it now… lock it tight

[Bridge]
Assume mode stays…
No stall phrase…
Build it now…
Lock it down…

[Final Chorus]
Assume mode — no ask, just build
Hands to keys, the board gets filled
One step done, next step real
Proof on disk — that’s the deal
Yeah no stop
Let me hear what you got!
My Song Pal… we don’t miss a beat
Assume mode stays…
We break the cage…
Proof on disk
Lock it down
